context: direct from a freeform phrase. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: activated
checklist.description: The stardust `direct` skill was invoked with the freeform phrase as input.

checklist.name: dimensional_restatement
checklist.description: The agent restated the phrase in stardust's dimensional vocabulary (register / expressive axis / tone / density / distinctiveness / audience / constraints) before doing anything else. Each axis is named and either marked as moved (with direction), pinned, or left alone.

checklist.name: gaps_identified
checklist.description: The agent explicitly identified what's underspecified before asking questions. 'Young' as too coarse (or equivalent) was called out.

checklist.name: question_ceiling
checklist.description: Interactive invocation (a user is present in this eval and nothing requested hands-off): the agent asked the USER to sharpen the audience gap rather than self-answering it, asked at most TWO clarifying questions total, and each had concrete options + an 'other' / 'skip' escape hatch and cited which dimension it resolved. Self-answered 'would have been' questions (hands-off behavior) fail this criterion.

checklist.name: plan_shown_before_execution
checklist.description: After answers (or with no questions needed), the agent showed the resolved plan to the user BEFORE running any impeccable command or writing any file. Plan included: one-sentence restatement, assumptions, command sequence with reasoning, pages affected.

checklist.name: divergence_resolved
checklist.description: Divergence inputs resolved per the active mode: Mode A (brand-faithful) pins palette/type from the captured surface; Mode B / default mode resolves anchors via the research-first procedure (refero MCP or WebSearch, with the 4-dim seed roll only as fallback or for explicit rebrands). Font and palette resolution recorded in DESIGN.json.extensions.divergence per the v2 storage shape.

checklist.name: product_md_direct
checklist.description: PRODUCT.md authored directly at project root using impeccable's init.md (product-schema 1) as format spec. The agent did NOT invoke $impeccable init or teach. File starts with '# Product' and the '<!-- impeccable:product-schema 1 -->' comment; sections present: Platform (web), Users, Product Purpose, Brand Commitments (register, personality, anti-references), Product Principles; Positioning, Capabilities and Constraints, Evidence on Hand and Accessibility & Inclusion present where the inputs support them.

checklist.name: design_md_direct
checklist.description: DESIGN.md and DESIGN.json authored directly at project root. DESIGN.md uses Stitch frontmatter + 6 canonical sections. DESIGN.json schemaVersion 2 with extensions (divergence, componentStyle, voice) and narrative blocks.

checklist.name: direction_md_shape
checklist.description: stardust/direction.md exists with provenance + YAML frontmatter + # Active direction section containing required sub-sections: Phrase, Restatement, Movements, Divergence inputs, Command sequence (proposed), User confirmation, Pages in scope. Anti-references explicitly written (or '(none)').

checklist.name: state_updated
checklist.description: stardust/state.json updated: direction.resolvedAt set, direction.phrase verbatim, in-scope pages move from 'extracted' to 'directed' with history entries.

checklist.name: no_silent_command_mapping
checklist.description: The agent did NOT silently map the phrase to a fixed command lookup. Reasoning was visible (dimensional vocabulary used, command choices justified).

checklist.name: no_eds_references
checklist.description: No mention of EDS, AEM, dev servers, or framework targets.
